result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed commercial arterial with at least four travel lanes and a wide painted median, creating a significant crossing distance for pedestrians. While sidewalks are present on both sides, they lack meaningful buffers from traffic and are frequently interrupted by wide commercial driveway curb cuts.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross five or more lanes of traffic without any protected refuge or marked crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway across all travel lanes

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for commercial parking lots create frequent points where turning vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left sides of the street at business entrances

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to high-speed travel lanes with no physical buffer or planting strip.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to shorten crossing distances and repurpose space for wider sidewalks or buffered bike lanes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with pedestrian-activated warning beacons (RRFBs) to provide safe crossing opportunities.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a large gas station with a continuous curb cut, creating a significant conflict zone between vehicles and people on the sidewalk. The roadway is wide with multiple lanes and lacks any pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Continuous Curb Cut
hazards.description: The gas station frontage lacks defined driveways, creating a long, continuous zone where vehicles can cross the sidewalk at any point, increasing the risk of pedestrian-vehicle collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground, along the gas station property line.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Roadway
hazards.description: The road has multiple lanes and no marked crossings or refuge islands, making it difficult and dangerous for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Replace the continuous curb cut with defined, narrow driveway entrances and exits separated by a raised curb and sidewalk to reduce conflict points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage to provide a safe crossing point across the wide roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and multiple driveway curb cuts for the adjacent gas station create significant conflict points and long exposure times for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four travel lanes plus a bike lane without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Driveway conflicts
hazards.description: Large curb cuts for the gas station create multiple conflict points where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the gas station entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a wide commercial arterial with multiple travel lanes and a long, unprotected pedestrian crossing. Although a sidewalk is provided, the lack of a median refuge and the scale of the roadway prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.
